messages:
dara: Quick sweep from the postmortem follow-upswe keep seeing the same tight-headroom + preemption spike pattern. Need owners and short roll timelines.

li: I can take a first pass on an automated mitigation: temporarily throttle large noninteractive allocs when committed usage >90%. Prototype by EOD Friday.

gonzalo: I'll own reserve pool work + admin opt-out toggle. Minimal rollout: 5% reserve for premium/system, one-region canary, rollback flag. Target 2026-04-09.

ops-bot: Created tasks: GPU-1820 (auto-throttle rule), GPU-1821 (reserve-pool + opt-out), GPU-1822 (scheduler-debounce + backoff), GPU-1823 (surge-ci job).

margo: I can do alerts + runbook. Proposal: warning at 78% committed, critical at 92%. Add a slack-warning channel + page at critical. Runbook quick steps: enable reserve pool, pause heavy batch jobs, escalate to infra lead.

li: Auto-throttle sketch (short):
```
if committed_pct > 90% and spike_rate > 10rps:
  reject noninteractive_large_jobs for 30m
  notify slack #infra-warning
```
I'll open GPU-1820 PR with tests.

gonzalo: Scheduler changes (short): add 6s preempt debounce, disable aggressive reclaim for 1h after rollout, prefer local-affinity for latency queues. Will include perf panels. PR target 2026-03-31.

sre-oncall: For canaries invite us to the validation window. Health gates: preemptions/hr <= baseline*1.3, P95 tail latency <= +12%. If gates fail auto-disable.

margo: CI surge job (GPU-1823) plan: 20m mixed-seq spike + KV warmup, run nightly for 10 days post-merge; failures should block merge and post PR comments.

dara: Owners + deadlines recap:
- GPU-1820 li (auto-throttle) -> 2026-03-26
- GPU-1821 gonzalo (reserve pool + opt-out) -> 2026-04-09
- GPU-1822 gonzalo (scheduler debounce) -> 2026-03-31
- GPU-1823 margo (surge CI + blocking tests) -> 2026-03-28
- alerts/runbook margo -> 2026-03-25

li: Cost guardrail note: propose temporary reserve up to 6 weeks with auto-rollback if cost delta >11%. I'll sync with finance.

gonzalo: Also adding a telemetry piece: emit per-tenant committed_pct and preempt_count rolling-1h to support anomaly detection. Will add to GPU-1824 (telemetry) and target 2026-03-29.

dara: Ops notes: Dedicated tenants must have opt-out. Also schedule a 15-min recurring check for 4 weeks to monitor recurrence. ops-bot, please create the invite.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-24T15:30Z. Calendar invite sent.

dara: Thanks all  I'll consolidate into the postmortem follow-ups doc and ping owners tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
